messages:
pagerduty-bot: [1820001111] ALERT: 3 high - infra-pg-reads - suppressed by routing policy (event: pd-api-timeout) — notify: oncall-sre

maria (sre-oncall): seeing PD alerts suppressed and duplicates in timeline. Alerts for pg-reads appear in PD for EU cluster only, US oncall not getting pages. Anyone else?

liam (eng-infra): yep getting duplicates -> 5 identical PD events in last 2m, looks like webhook retries + routing rule re-inserted them. PD console shows 'delivery succeeded' but our webhook shows 429s

jay (observability): confirm: Datadog -> PD integration shows 429s from PD between 03:12:05-03:14:40 UTC. Stack: `curl -i https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue` returned 429 body: `{"error":"rate_limited","message":"Too Many Requests"}`

maria (sre-oncall): customer-impact? any alerts missed?

sarah (customer-support): Support triage: we've had 6 customer tickets about delayed incident response in last 20m. One SLA at risk (ACME Corp)

liam (eng-infra): workaround: pause dedupe/routing-policy that was causing reroutes. I'm toggling the "regional-failover" routing rule to bypass. Doing now: `pd rules update --id R-1234 --enabled false`

pagerduty-bot: ACK: rule R-1234 disabled by liam at 03:18 UTC

maria (sre-oncall): re-run healthcheck to ensure US oncall receives new alerts. Triggering synthetic alert: `curl -X POST https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue -d '{...}'`

jay (observability): test alert delivered to PD -> US oncall: liam, sarah got page. Good.

maria (sre-oncall): flipping suppression back? Not yet. We need vendor status.

liam (eng-infra): created PD support ticket #INC-8901. PD status page shows degraded notify delivery & routing loops in their EU transit region. Link: https://status.pagerduty.com/incidents/xyz (PD says mitigations rolling out)

maria (sre-oncall): notify customer success for affected accounts: @sarah prioritize ACME, BetaCorp

sarah (customer-support): notified, opening temporary escalation for ACME. Slack DM to account owner sent.

maria (sre-oncall): doing on-call handoff in 40m to @jay — but if PD still flaky escalate to phone tree. @jay you good to take if still noisy?

jay (observability): yes, I'll take handoff and monitor PD ticket. I'll also enable our fallback PagerBridge SMS for high-severity (script below)

liam (eng-infra): forwarding snippet to enable pagerbridge: 
```
# enable pagerbridge fallback
kubectl apply -f pagerbridge-config.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/pagerbridge
```

maria (sre-oncall): timeline & impact capture for postmortem: suspicious window 03:12-03:20 UTC, ~120 alerts suppressed, 6 customer tickets, 2 escalations, avg ack delay ~14m for affected teams.

pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-2026-03-15-evtX by liam. Ticket link sent to pd support.

jay (observability): escalation: open internal P0 with vendor? who owns vendor liaison?

liam (eng-infra): assigning to emily (vendor-ops) — @emily please coordinate with PD SE and get ETA.

emily (vendor-ops): on it, pinged PD SE, they asked for recent webhook logs and timestamps; I'm attaching logs to the PD ticket.

maria (sre-oncall): mitigation summary for execs: brief note: "PagerDuty experienced transient routing/delivery issues causing alert suppression for US oncall between 03:12-03:20 UTC. We temporarily disabled a regional routing rule and enabled SMS fallback; customers ACME/BetaCorp impacted; actions: vendor engaged, postmortem owner: maria." I'll draft email.

sarah (customer-support): customer comms draft: short apology, explain mitigation + ETA for root cause. I'll get legal signoff on wording.

jay (observability): FYI we've captured logs: `curl` retries, PD 429s, and PD console shows duplicate enrichments — looks like PD retry logic + our dedupe rule caused loop.

maria (sre-oncall): handoff: @jay takes on-call at 03:50 UTC. On-call runbook step: if PD delivery remains degraded >15m escalate to phone tree and enable full PagerBridge SMS.

jay (observability): noted. Will monitor PD status page & ticket. Setting a 15m check-in timer.

maria (sre-oncall): post-incident action items: 
- owner: liam -> add circuit breaker and queueing on PD webhook to avoid retry storms
- owner: jay -> add health alerts to detect PD 4xx/5xx spikes
- owner: emily -> follow up with PD SE and get RCA
- owner: sarah -> draft customer comms and postmortem

liam (eng-infra): starting quick PR for webhook backoff: `def send_event(): backoff = min(60, attempts*2)`

pagerduty-bot: note: PD incident updated to "mitigating" at 03:35 UTC; will monitor.

maria (sre-oncall): closing initial thread and will move to #postmortems after handoff. Thanks all. :heart:

jay (observability): thanks — will update if anything new."
